definitions.explanation: selecting someone for an important position based on talent rather than seniority

examples.japanese: ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A young person was promoted to department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢|ばってき}だった。
⟦{才能|さいのう}→才能：02772_sainou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見込|みこ}まれて→見込む：08315_mikomu⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: They were selected because their talent was recognized.

notes:
{抜擢|ばってき} means selecting someone for an important position based on talent rather than seniority — a departure from Japan's traditional ⟦{年功序列|ねんこうじょれつ}→年功序列：12532_nenkoujoretsu⟧ (seniority) system, so it is often called ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧ (unusual).

WRITING: {擢|てき} is a rare kanji; the word is sometimes written {抜|ばっ}てき.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {抜擢|ばってき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ / ⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧: to select/promote / to be selected
- ⟦{異例|いれい}→異例：13564_irei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{抜擢|ばってき}: an unusual promotion
- ⟦{若手|わかて}→若手：13989_wakate⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{抜擢|ばってき}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to promote young talent

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {抜擢|ばってき}: merit-based, often unexpected, skips seniority
- ⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧: ordinary, expected career advancement
- ⟦{登用|とうよう}→登用：17153_touyou⟧ / ⟦{起用|きよう}→起用：14397_kiyou⟧: appointment to a role, without the merit-over-seniority implication

REGISTER: Formal; common in business news and official announcements.
